federation.bad_admin: Only admins can be given a federation.
federation.bad_group: Group {id} is not a known group.
federation.default_fixed: The Default federation holds the groups in no other federation; only its admins can be changed.
federation.malformed: The body must be a JSON object of name, group_ids and admin_ids.
federation.name: A federation's name is 1 to {max} characters, without control characters.
federation.too_many_groups: A federation holds at most {max} groups.
fwd.bad_channel: Enter the Discord channel ID (the numeric id, from Developer Mode, Copy Channel ID).
fwd.bad_token: That does not look like a Telegram bot token (123456789:AA...).
fwd.bad_webhook: That does not look like a Discord webhook URL (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...).
fwd.chat_kind: chat_kind is group for a group (a negative chat_id) and user for a private chat (a positive one).
fwd.d2t_required: discord_channel_id, chat_id, bot_token, types and enabled are required.
fwd.duplicate: That Discord channel already forwards to that Telegram chat.
fwd.in_use: This route has forwarded {count} message(s), which are still linked to it. Disable it instead of deleting it.
fwd.t2d_required: chat_id, chat_kind, webhook_url, types and enabled are required.
fwd.test_message: Test message from the tgloggerd Discord integration: the webhook works.
fwd.test_required: Give the id of a saved webhook or a webhook_url to test.
fwd.test_unreachable: Could not reach Discord. Try again later.
notice.email: Your email address was changed (sent to the old and the new address)
notice.new_device: Someone signed in from a new device or browser
notice.password: Your password was changed or reset
pins.limit: At most {max} groups can be pinned; unpin one first.
prefs.invalid: The value of {key} is not one it takes.
prefs.malformed: The body must be a JSON object of preferences.
search.limit: At most {max} searches can be saved; delete one first.
search.title: A saved search needs a title of at most 128 characters.
search.url: A saved search must be a path on this site, of at most 2048 bytes.
